title: Proposal for Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation Cardholders to Receive Subsidies for Certain Traditional Chinese Medicine Treatments
what_it_is: Proposal for Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation Cardholders to Receive Subsidies for Certain Traditional Chinese Medicine Treatments

sections.label: PG and MG outpatient benefits
sections.summary: The PG and MG packages help Pioneers and Merdeka Generation seniors afford subsidised services and medications at public healthcare institutions and Community Health Assist Scheme clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Pioneer Generation (PG) package and the Merdeka Generation (MG) package outpatient benefits have been designed to help Pioneers and Merdeka Generation seniors better afford subsidised services and medications at public healthcare institutions, as well as at clinics participating in the Community Health Assist Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There are currently no plans to extend PG and MG subsidies to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) clinics as TCM plays a complementary role in our healthcare system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health provides support for TCM development in various ways, including funding and support for TCM capability development, continuing education as well as research.

sections.label: Charitable TCM clinics
sections.summary: There are more than 50 charitable TCM clinics as of today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As of today, there are more than 50 charitable TCM clinics.

sections.label: Acupuncture subsidies and TCM study
sections.summary: PG subsidies cover certain acupuncture treatments at Singapore General Hospital and Sengkang Hospital, and MG benefits will extend from 1 November.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: For the efficacy and safety of the treatment, in this case acupuncture, particularly the context of pain management and post-stroke rehabilitation, this will be considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Indeed, the Member might wish to know that PG subsidies are already available for acupuncture treatments, not all forms, but for certain types of acupuncture treatments at the Singapore General Hospital and Sengkang Hospital.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And the MG benefits will also extend when the package is rolled out on 1 November.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: For all other aspects of TCM, including acupuncture at other Public Healthcare Institutions, we will consider to study the efficacy and safety and decide incrementally when to introduce them.
